name: barrier-visualization
description: Produce a structured barrier report for AutoWS (automatic warp specialization) IR. Use when the user wants to visualize, audit, or debug barrier usage across warp-specialized partitions, or when debugging a GPU kernel hang (deadlock). For hangs, first dump IR using the ir-debugging skill, then run this barrier analysis to find the barrier that actually deadlocks -- reasoning with the mbarrier phase model (NOT raw arrive/wait counts, which give false positives), plus missing backward barriers and other synchronization issues. Covers mbarriers, named barriers, tcgen05 commit, TMA-implicit arrives, Aref-based synchronization, and producer/consumer barrier patterns.
